title: Jörg Klebingat
vital_facts: Baptized as a teen, Aaronic Priesthood shortly thereafter; Melchizedek Priesthood as young adult.
Full time Missionary in Colorado Denver Mission.
Married Julia Poltorak in the Salt Lake Temple on Dec. 21, 1992
Bachelor's degree, Russian Language from BYU; Master's degree in Organizational Behavior, BYU Marriott School of Management.
Business Management Consultant for Price Waterhouse, and Arthur Andersen, and a variety of jobs for the Church
Elders Quorum President, Young Men President, High Councilor, Branch President and Bishop.
President of the Ukraine Kyiv (Kiev) Mission, 2011 - 2014.
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
